text: 因涉嫌违反账户实名制等规定，被立案近两个月后，国盛证券与湘财证券同日收到监管下发的行政处罚及行政监管措施事先告知书，拟暂停两家券商新开证券账户3个月。9月24日，国盛证券公告称，公司及相关当事人收到江西证监局下发的《行政处罚事先告知书》《行政监管措施事先告知书》。同日，湘财股份公告称，子公司湘财证券收到湖南证监局下发的《行政处罚事先告知书》和相关行政监管措施事先告知书。两家券商均于7月31日被中国证监会立案。（澎湃）
text_en: After nearly two months of being under investigation for suspected violations of regulations including the real-name account system, Guosheng Securities and Xiangcai Securities received prior notification letters from regulators on the same day regarding administrative penalties and administrative regulatory measures, with plans to suspend the opening of new securities accounts at both brokerages for three months. On September 24, Guosheng Securities announced that the company and relevant parties received the "Prior Notice of Administrative Penalty" and "Prior Notice of Administrative Regulatory Measures" issued by the Jiangxi Regulatory Bureau of the CSRC. On the same day, Xiangcai Co. announced that its subsidiary Xiangcai Securities received the "Prior Notice of Administrative Penalty" and related prior notice of administrative regulatory measures issued by the Hunan Regulatory Bureau of the CSRC. Both brokerages were placed under investigation by the CSRC on July 31. (The Paper)
